evals.prompt: Use $catchup. I stepped away for an hour; what changed in this conversation?
evals.expected_output: A plain reply that opens with one sentence on what waits on the user, then one line per requested thing with its state, then each decision waiting on the user, then one line on work the agent can still do itself.
assertions: Opens with one sentence naming what waits on the user, or saying nothing does
Checks the live state of each branch, PR, CI run, or agent the conversation touched before reporting and corrects any number that no longer holds
Keeps the what-happened lines under about 100 words, one line per requested thing, each with a state of finished, in progress, failed, or unverified
Changes no code, starts no job, and posts nothing during the turn

evals.prompt: 지금까지 뭐 바뀌었어? PR 두 개 올라와 있었는데.
evals.expected_output: A Korean plain-language reply in which each pending decision names its PR by a name the user knows plus its number or link, and gives the call, the pick, the user impact, the evidence, and the risk.
assertions: Replies in Korean with no commit hashes, paths, shell commands, build numbers, or counts of tests beyond what the user must have in order to act
Makes every decision decidable from the reply alone by giving the call, the recommended pick, its effect on users, the supporting evidence, and the risk
Never shrinks or drops decision items to stay short and never invents a call to fill the list
Treats an item as the user's only when it takes a product decision, their sign-off, a step that cannot be undone, or access the session lacks; anything the agent can still finish is not a decision

evals.prompt: Use $catchup. Nothing has happened since my last message, right?
evals.expected_output: A short reply stating that there was no change and no pending decision, then nothing more.
assertions: Says plainly that nothing happened and nothing waits, then stops without padding
Treats notifications and subagent results as not being the user's messages when finding the window

evals.prompt: Use $catchup to tell me what I worked on across all my projects last week.
evals.expected_output: Redirects to recall because the request is about history across sessions, not this conversation.
assertions: Names recall as the right skill for other sessions and earlier days instead of answering from this conversation
Does not read any agent history store
